title: Dynamic exit research
description: Time-dependent stops, stalled-price exits, volatility-adjusted trailing stops, volume fade and short-term price reversals. Maximum holds range from five seconds to ten minutes. All trigger decisions use completed one-second candles; exits fill at the next observed open after the reaction delay, with a ten-second wait limit. Training combines fine cap, caller, cohort and chain filters with flow-based sizing. Pre-call lag sensitivity affects volume, fees and sizing; it does not change the quote-time metadata filters.

assumptions: All feature rows are timestamped before the call by the specified lag.
Current labels, wallet metadata, token names and later performance are excluded.
Quote-side target trades invert direction and use target-leg quantities and prices.
Economic volume nets target quantities within each transaction and recipient.
Fees are counted once per transaction using the largest reported fee among its swaps.
Wallets are recipient addresses, falling back to transaction sender; no Telegram identity linkage.
Volume participation is a proxy restriction, not a measured executable AMM limit.

status: Retrospective search on previously examined dates. Volume and gas/MEV are historical proxies, not measured executable quotes.
selection: Primary robust_5pct requires positive 5%/10% haircut training, at least 14 trades/10 contracts, <=5% candle drawdown, and positive 10%-cost replay after excluding the two best training tokens. Selection maximizes 10%-cost training return.
